content.title: scratch
content.body:
22 Jul
Northline froze hiring. Dex says wait it out. I keep refreshing the all-hands deck like it will grow a paragraph that includes me.

29 Jul
Harbor Path found me. I didn't look. That's the sentence I want to be able to say later and I'm already not sure it's true. I opened their site after the all-hands.

4 Aug
Told Mina I was tired. I was. Also I had a call in a stairwell like a person who has already decided something and is pretending he hasn't.

8 Aug
They want me in Harboridge. I said vendor overnight. The lie was ready before I needed it. That should have been the moment.

11 Aug, 1:13a, The Wren
The room is fine. The city looks like a place people stay. I thought about calling her and I opened Mara's thread instead. I don't know what that means and I hate that I don't.

12 Aug, airport
Priya said no Kingswell split, kindly. I nodded like a man considering commutes. I am considering leaving. Those are not the same and I keep using one word for both.

13 Aug, 12:50a
She's asleep. The draft is still a draft. If she asks in the morning I will say I was at a vendor thing. I can hear how it sounds and I'm still going to say it.
